text: This solution, Modernization and Densification of National Seismic Monitoring Infrastructure addresses natural catastrophe in People’s Republic of China between China Earthquake Administration (CEA), Ministry of Emergency Management, China Earthquake Network Center, Provincial earthquake bureaus, and National Earthquake Science Data Center. The program was implemented in 2021 and focuses on collaboration, leveraging tech, and regulation.
